description: This file defines the DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator class responsible for evaluating and testing database user permissions via schema modifications and SQL queries within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for creating tables, performing CRUD operations, altering schema, and managing foreign keys to assess permissions.

classes.name: DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator
classes.description: A class that evaluates database permissions by performing schema manipulations and SQL queries to verify create, read, update, delete, alter, foreign key, and drop permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the evaluator with a Doctrine DBAL Connection.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns the schema helper instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: evalCreatePermission
methods.description: Tests create table and column permissions by creating a temporary table with various column types.

methods.name: evalCrudPermission
methods.description: Performs CRUD operations (insert, select, update, delete) on a temporary table to assess CRUD permissions.

methods.name: evalAlterPermission
methods.description: Tests alter table permissions by adding, changing, renaming, and dropping a column.

methods.name: evalForeignKeyPermission
methods.description: Creates tables and foreign keys, tests foreign key constraints, and cleans up, assessing foreign key permissions.

methods.name: evalDropPermission
methods.description: Drops created tables to evaluate drop permissions.

methods.name: evalPrivilegeDatabaseUserPermission
methods.description: Runs a sequence of permission tests including create, alter, foreign key, and drop operations to evaluate overall user privileges.
